summaryZh: Kadonaga 实验室研究 RNA 聚合酶 II 转录调控和染色质功能。其核心启动子研究覆盖 DNA 元件、转录因子和生物网络三个层次。页面还介绍了已报告的工作：使用SVR机器学习模型研究人类下游核心启动子区（DPR）及TATA盒。
researchQuestions: 哪些 DNA 信号引导转录起始？
methods: 支持向量回归（SVR）建模（已报告的人类DPR和TATA盒研究）

evidence.quote: In my lab, we study the regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.
We are also interested in the biological functions of chromatin
We study core promoters at three levels: DNA elements, transcription factors, and biological networks.
In my lab, we study the regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

We study core promoters at three levels: DNA elements, transcription factors, and biological networks. (1). RNA polymerase II core promoter: DNA elements First, it is essential to identify the DNA-based signals that direct the initiation of transcription.

This puzzle was ultimately solved by using machine learning (Vo ngoc et al., 2020) (Fig. 2). In this work, we generated a machine learning (support vector regression, SVR) model for the human downstream core promoter region (DPR), which encompasses the positions of the Drosophila MTE and DPE (Fig. 1).
